variations.name: The Ledger
variations.rationale: A letterpress broadsheet: warm paper stock, a centered masthead set in old-style serif, hairline rules and a real editorial grid. The delight is a Tufte-style sidenote system — each record entry carries a margin gloss that draws its red leader rule and slides in on hover or focus, while a folio bar with a reading-progress hairline slips down once you leave the masthead. Every note sits in normal document flow on small screens, so nothing depends on hover or script.

variations.name: Orbit
variations.rationale: A quiet observatory. A canvas starfield drifts and leans toward the pointer behind a centered orbital diagram whose three dashed rings carry satellites around a core stamped with the current role; the three focus areas are pinned around the system as labels that light their own ring on hover. Below, the record runs as a luminous timeline. The diagram is decorative and aria-hidden, so the identical facts read as plain text with canvas, script, or motion disabled.

variations.name: Blueprint
variations.rationale: A drafting sheet: cyan hairline grid on deep navy, plate callouts, dimension lines and a proper title block anchoring the page. The interaction is a drafting crosshair with a live coordinate readout that tracks the pointer, paired with SVG plate rules that ink themselves in on scroll via stroke-dashoffset. Both effects are pointer-and-motion gated; the underlying document is a plain, fully readable technical spec.

variations.name: Overprint
variations.rationale: A risograph poster on cream stock: fluorescent pink and blue inks knocked together with multiply blending, halftone fields, hard-shadow blocks and slabs set at a tilt. The signature move is misregistration — duplicate ink layers of the headline slide against the pointer, and a Shift Inks button (keyboard-operable) re-rolls the plate offsets and swaps the palette. The black plate is the real text, duplicates are aria-hidden, and reduced motion locks a tidy static registration.

variations.name: Specimen
variations.rationale: The site as a type specimen sheet: pure white, one red, a colossal grotesque name, and every block of content labelled in the gutter with its point size like a foundry proof. Two interactions carry it — the name is split into letters that lift, tilt and redden as the cursor passes, and a native range slider live-sets the tracking of the headline with a mono readout, so it is fully keyboard operable. Without script the name renders as ordinary text and the slider simply disappears.
